summary: Not ready to merge. The phrase cutter, WAV encoding, fixed Groq model, omission of language/prompt, ordered insertion, failure markers and corrected failure-toast formatting implement the central requirements; voice.html is unchanged. However, closing Quick Idea cannot cancel a pending microphone startup, and cancellation does not abort tidy requests, which can block subsequent dictation. The tester reports 17 passing tests and one failing permission-race regression. My npm test invocation could not execute browser assertions because Chromium startup was denied by the sandbox (Operation not permitted); node tests/verify.js passed. This branch also predates current main: the large direct diff reflects divergent history, not task-04 deleting those features, but integration with main and preservation of its existing behavior still require validation.
findings: HIGH — js/markdown/dictation.js:249-274, 434-468: stopDictation only cancels sessions that already exist, whereas startApi creates its session after awaiting getUserMedia. Open Quick Idea, press its microphone, close the modal while permission is pending, then grant permission: recording starts into the hidden idea field and the track remains active. Track a cancellable startup operation and its target before loadSettings/getUserMedia; invalidate it on discard, check it after each await, and stop any late-arriving stream without creating capture nodes, uploads, text or error toasts. Keep and pass adversarial.spec.js's pending-permission test; also cover closing and reopening before permission resolves so an old startup cannot attach to the new modal.

MEDIUM — js/markdown/dictation.js:298-318 and tidyUp: the session AbortController is passed to transcription but not to the chat-completions fetch. With tidy enabled, hold two idea tidy responses, close Quick Idea, then dictate into the editor: both global pool slots remain occupied by cancelled work until those responses finish, so editor transcription cannot start. Pass the slot signal through tidyUp to fetch and ensure abort unwinds runSlot and releases its pool slot without insertion or a failure toast. Add a regression with two pending tidy requests that verifies closing the idea modal aborts them and a subsequent editor phrase proceeds immediately.

MERGE INTEGRATION — The branch does not contain current main (merge base fcc6d05, main 652b9a7). Reconcile the shared-file changes with main before approval and test the resulting tree. In particular, adapt main's setBtn stop-label/title/aria behavior to the new target-aware signature instead of replacing it with class toggling; retain the Quick Idea chapter picker and saveIdea reentrancy guard, and preserve unrelated diagram/sketch and Song work. Reconcile the independently added Playwright configuration so task-04 and existing suites remain runnable, retaining PW_CHROME_PATH support. These are integration requirements, not a claim that task-04 itself deleted the main-only features.
